mission: Full Adumar factory sequence in a single continuous scene: Jacen and Ben conduct a theatrical GA-inspector tour of the Dammant Killers missile facility under local guide Testan ke Harran; use Force-reading of Testan's guilty thoughts to locate a concealed corridor; Ben cuts through the wall with his 'practice' lightsaber; the Dammant Killers security force engages; Jacen defends with lightsaber deflection while Ben records evidence on a holocam; the pair escape through the assembly-line portals.
why_now: Jacen's GA-sanctioned inspection cover is time-limited; the performance must carry them to the hidden stockpile before the factory pushes back.
opening_hook: The turbolift doors slide open and warm air bearing the aroma of death and destruction — labor, propellant, high explosives, newly fabricated composites — washes over Jacen Solo, his cousin Ben Skywalker, and their guide.
conflict: Jacen and Ben against the Dammant Killers' institutional discipline and security apparatus — first through social engineering, then through Force-reading of a specific concealed memory, then through open combat when the facility's troops deploy.
turning_point: Testan's mental control gives way under the pressure of Jacen's silent Force-presence. Jacen extracts the memory of a concealed broad gray door closing from above, supervisors in dark blue jumpsuits scurrying out ahead of it. Ben cuts a meter-and-a-half circle through the matching wall panel with his lightsaber. The facility's orange-and-green troops charge the corridor. The raid is committed.
closing_hook: Jacen squeezes through the diminutive portal at the end of an assembly line — following Ben, who has just landed and scrambled through ahead of him — while behind them the surviving troopers continue firing into the conveyor belt they have just vaulted.
setting: Interior of the Dammant Killers subterranean missile-manufacturing facility in the city of Cartann on Adumar. A manufacturing chamber the size of four squadron hangar-and-maintenance bays, divided into eight assembly lanes by duracrete partitions. Luminous white conveyor belts run materials through worker stations. An observation catwalk ringed above the floor. Behind a camouflaged wall panel: a hidden corridor packed with DAMMANT KILLER MODEL 16 transport containers. Beyond the corridor: a second assembly chamber with its own observation balcony.
sensory_details: Smells of worker sweat, machine lubricant, newly fabricated composite materials, solid fuel propellants, high explosives — not flesh or gangrene, the odors of industry. The billowing of Jacen's Jedi cloak as he strides. The ring of his boot heels on the metal catwalk. Testan ke Harran's flowing orange-and-purple diamond-patterned tunic with gold trousers, belt, and scarf; his lustrous conditioned black beard. Luminous-green high-explosive spheres the size of a human head — Adumari concussion-missile warheads — carried on conveyor belts by hazmat-suited workers. Sensor-assembly workers plugging cables into units and watching black-and-white monitor feeds. The musical rap of rubber-headed hammers against missile-casing housings. Orange-and-green Dammant Killers security uniforms (reminiscent of X-wing pilot orange with speeder-bike-style green armor). Jacen's green lightsaber blade reflected in the walls and armor. The smell of burned flesh as troopers fall to friendly fire. The snap-hiss of Ben's blue saber cutting through durasteel panel; the glowing edges of the cut. The clang of the panel falling away into the hidden chamber.
emotional_trajectory: Theatrical calm and social engineering → rising Force-pressure as Testan's guilty thought leaks → explosive commitment to combat → controlled battlefield defense → mission expansion (record evidence) → escape.

stakes.personal: Jacen's operational authority in the field and his use of the Solo name for theatrical weight.
stakes.interpersonal: Ben's first field operation under Jacen's mentorship — the apprentice register locking in through action, not instruction.
stakes.external: The Dammant Killers missile pipeline to Corellia, and the admissible-in-GA-court evidence Ben is recording on holocam.

canon_elements_needed: Adumar as Corellian-adjacent world with a pilot-culture fascination — the Solo name carries extra weight here because Adumar remembers Han Solo
Adumari phonetic accent, rendered phonetically on the page ('ar workars,' 'duracrete barriars,' 'whar you are,' 'saction,' 'farce' for 'force')
Cartann as the Adumari capital city
Dammant Killers as Corellian paramilitary missile contractor — they make the DAMMANT KILLER MODEL 16 concussion missile, crated in lots of 24

Adumari concussion-missile manufacturing line: luminous-green high-explosive spheres (head-sized) handled by hazmat-suited workers; sensor assembly stations with black-and-white monitor feedback; composite missile casings checked for cracks with rubber-headed hammers
Orange-and-green Dammant Killers security uniforms (X-wing-pilot-orange with stormtrooper-speeder-bike-style green carapace armor)
Ben's holocam — a small, expensive holocam unit of the sort a wealthy vacationer would carry — used here to record evidence admissible in a GA court
Jedi lightsaber deflection of blaster bolts; lightsaber cutting through durasteel wall panels (the cut glows with residual heat)
The 'from a certain point of view' phrase (Obi-Wan Kenobi's Return of the Jedi quote) as Jacen humor-beat when Ben's practice lightsaber turns out to cut wall panels
Han Solo wisdom quoted by Ben mid-escape: 'you never want to fight the enemy on ground he's chosen if you can avoid it'
The Jedi Order's post-NJO reputation — more widespread and more supernatural each year under Luke Skywalker's leadership
action_beats: The turbolift doors open and the factory's aroma washes over Jacen, Ben, and Testan
Jacen makes his theatrical entrance onto the catwalk — billowing cloak, ringing boot heels — leaving Testan and Ben a beat behind; this is performance, and he knows he is selling it

Ben pretends to translate Testan's Adumari-accented speech for Jacen, who understands Testan clearly but has chosen the act; Ben keeps Testan occupied with the beard-oil jokes ('Do you brush it with butter?')

Jacen surveys the eight assembly lanes — sensor units, casing housings, hazmat-suited workers plunging sensors into luminous-green explosive spheres — and reads the facility's rhythm through the Force
Testan's mental control slips; Jacen says his first words in the guide's presence — 'There is something here. Something wrong' — and tracks a concealed memory of a broad gray door
Jacen walks the catwalk toward the matching wall panel, his speed increasing the ring of his boots and the billow of his cloak as a side effect rather than an act
Ben cuts a meter-and-a-half circle through the wall panel with his 'practice' lightsaber; Jacen tells Testan it's true from a certain point of view — Ben does practice with it
Discovery: the hidden corridor, DAMMANT KILLER MODEL 16 transport containers stacked in lots of 24, marked DANGER, DO NOT DROP
Dammant Killers security — orange-and-green troops in waves of six, then six again, then eight — charges the corridor; Jacen ignites his green saber and tells Ben 'Stay behind me'
Jacen moves forward at a walk, twirling the blade in a butterfly pattern, calling back to the troopers: 'Could you speak up? I'm a little deaf' — Ben snickers
Jacen deflects blaster bolts back into the trooper ranks; the commander falls to a helmet-ricochet (non-fatal); four troopers fall to friendly fire in the opening seconds

The team reaches the rail overlooking a second assembly chamber; Ben records evidence on holocam — 'Um, this is Ben Skywalker. Jedi Knight Jacen Solo and I are in a secret part of the Dammant Killers plant... their guys are trying to kill us' — while Jacen provides lightsaber defense

Ben vaults the rail, lands on a conveyor belt loaded with opalescent shell casings, sprints forward and squeezes through the diminutive portal at the line's end; Jacen follows, taking one blaster bolt on his blade near the hilt rather than deflecting it into a neighboring line
notes: This is the novel's first action sequence and the primary establishment of the Jacen-Ben field-operative dynamic. Target ~4500 words matching Allston's empirical range for an action chapter. Register is Allston dialogue-forward — performance and banter carry the discovery half; precise combat choreography carries the action half. Humor is load-bearing: Ben's beard-oil-and-butter jokes, Jacen's 'I'm a little deaf' quip, the 'certain point of view' beat. Testan's Adumari phonetic accent must be rendered on the page. Ben's holocam monologue is the mission's evidence-gathering purpose, not a quirk — the GA court needs admissible footage. Jacen's economy of violence is visible but not yet sinister: he aims for non-fatal outcomes (helmet ricochet knocking the commander out, bolt deflections into the ranks rather than into worker stations, the accident that nearly hit an explosive package). Nelani Dinn is NOT in this scene — she joins the investigation later (Ch 2+).
